prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: Deep Orbit neural-networks/layers-and-architecture, concept section. Generate one new landscape 1536x1024 story composition, not a collage. Input images: the first 1 are canonical character identity references; the final image is the engineering set reference. Preserve recognizable faces, ages, skin tones, hair, uniforms and equipment. Cast only: Chief Nazari, woman aged 48 with mature facial lines, weathered tan skin, short dark hair streaked with gray, olive engineering coverall. Scene: Nazari inspects a small three-stage network sketch on an upright engineering screen, three rectangular layer panels connected from left to right, a wider middle-stage grouping and one small output marker. She holds a compact unlettered calculation slate in both hands at waist level and looks thoughtfully from slate to display. Her face shows practical interest and a tiny raised eyebrow. Tool wall, brass trim, inactive old cabinet behind. No physical robot, no tangled neuron cloud, no technical numerals. Tone: inviting, engaging, quietly lighthearted through competence, curiosity and natural human reactions. Anatomy and spatial constraints: exactly 1 human, each with two arms and two hands attached naturally. Hands have plausible fingers and grasp objects cleanly. No extra limbs, duplicated hands, detached fingers, fused bodies, floating props, or characters embedded in furniture. Bodies occupy open floor space; solid console and bench edges remain intact. Visible warmly lit faces, never silhouettes or back-only crew. No readable text, letters, numerals, logos or watermark. ARIA, only when requested, is a thin simple ring containing one horizontal waveform, never a face or ornamental spirograph. cel-shaded cartoon illustration, clean bold linework, flat shading with one soft key light, slightly stylized proportions, cinematic character and environment framing, near-black space beyond the viewports, green #6BAA8A interface glow and rim light, warm brass #A89060 metal trim, cohesive series look, not photorealistic. Remove inherited background pseudo-equations and tiny gibberish from the master reference. Background screens contain only sparse plain lines or simple waveforms. No invented letters, decorative scientific symbols, planets or crystals inside data tiles.
Targeted correction after QA: Use case: precise-object-edit. Change ONLY the big foreground screen diagram. Replace the current counted circles with three simple solid rectangular layer panels in a left-to-right chain: the first wide, the second narrower, the last narrowest. Use a uniform soft green fill in each panel, NO interior dots, cell grids, circles, numerals or node counts. Add only a thin connector between adjacent panels. These symbolic panels must not claim incorrect counts for the lesson's 32/16/1 network. Preserve Nazari's exact face, two hands holding the tablet, body, clothes, camera, engineering room and warm light. No other changes.
